scope: external controlled-release stress test using the public Stanford 2024-2025 campaign

label_contract.reason: Only intentional zero-release controls are definitive negatives. The primary positive boundary follows the paper's approximate best-case S2/Landsat detectability boundary; all lower nonzero releases remain an immutable challenge stratum.

product_contract.sentinel_2: exact public Level-1C acquisition within 180 seconds of the metered overpass
product_contract.landsat: exact USGS Collection 2 Level-1 Landsat 8/9 acquisition within 180 seconds of the metered overpass

selection_contract.allowed: external confirmation after architecture, checkpoint, crop geometry, reference rule, and threshold are frozen
selection_contract.forbidden: training, checkpoint selection, threshold selection, or iterative tuning on these outcomes

claim_boundaries: The cohort contains only two physical sites.
It cannot replace the official MARS-S2L full or test-only-site benchmark views.
Site-block uncertainty is descriptive with two groups and cannot establish broad geographic superiority.
Any exact product or geographic overlap with MARS must be reported before scoring.
Subthreshold observations are reported separately and never relabeled after outcomes are known.
outcome_sequence: Resolve and hash exact target products without model inference.
Audit exact-product and geographic overlap against all MARS metadata.
Freeze crop geometry, temporal-reference rule, checkpoint hashes, and threshold.
Acquire only required windows and bands into ignored storage.
Score each target once and report all scenes, primary confusion counts, and challenge sensitivity.
